'''Saba Reese''' was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Striar/Legends|Striar]] in the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Saba Reese was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]], except [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
